_help: Settings for your Faceless Video Factory. Edit with Notepad. Keep the quotes and commas.
niche: mind-blowing facts about science, space, history, animals and the human body
auto_post_help: true = post every video automatically (no Approve tap). false = wait for your Approve in Telegram.
voice_options_help: Curious storyteller voices: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural (default), en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural, en-US-ChristopherNeural, en-US-GuyNeural, en-US-AriaNeural, en-US-JennyNeural, en-GB-RyanNeural, en-AU-WilliamNeural
make_times_help: Edmonton time. Videos post about 20 minutes later: lunch, after school/work and evening peak in North America.
hindi_post_times_help: India time. Hindi videos wait in a queue and post at these prime times.
gemini_help: Leave empty here. Your key is stored safely in GitHub Secrets (GEMINI_API_KEY).
pexels_help: OPTIONAL. Free key from https://www.pexels.com/api/. With it, videos use real stock footage. Without it, animated backgrounds are used.
wikipedia_help: Real photos from Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (free, no key). Only public-domain, CC0 and CC BY photos are used, with the credit shown on screen.
caption_style_help: yellow, white, green or pink. This is the color of the highlighted word.
youtube_help: Not used in the cloud version yet.
